principle: Control family-wise error at 0.05 within scientific outcome families; do not claim study-wide FWER across separate families. Preserve original p values, prior FDR columns and the complete search inventory.

original_families.global_phiid: All five original global measures: persistent synergy, persistent redundancy, total synergy, Phi and Phi_R. No splitting Phi from Phi_R.
original_families.primary: FPN gateway count, the single endpoint named in the original TMS proposal before these analyses
original_families.other_network_gateways: All seven other network gateway counts

datasets: Separate studies and estimands: SUDMEX baseline-adjusted active-versus-sham follow-up; Aachen mean of both within-person intensity changes. No pooling of independent studies into a single causal effect.
aachen_method: Exact two-sided single-step max-absolute-t over all 32768 joint participant sign flips, separately within each original family. Same sign for all endpoints of a participant. Assumes joint symmetry of paired errors under relevant null hypotheses. This is not randomization of active versus sham treatment.
holm_check: Holm adjusted two-sided parametric p values within the same families for every table; valid under arbitrary endpoint dependence when individual p values are valid. Show Holm and max-T together, do not pick the smaller per endpoint.
secondary_contrasts: For new Aachen discoveries, combine 90-change, 120-change and intensity-difference contrasts within each outcome family, rather than declaring each intensity a separate opportunity. Treat covariate-adjusted variants as sensitivity checks, not independent discoveries.
broader_screen_families: All 24 network continuous measures form one family, all 14 subcortical measures one family, all 10 clinical moderators one family, all 9 multivariate tests one family; retain cross-contrast adjustment for Aachen secondary discoveries.
clinical_family: All seven baseline-adjusted clinical outcomes, Holm; 35 original brain-clinical associations are a separate association family.
normalization: Use the same endpoint families for an explicitly separate robustness branch. A normalized-only finding is a new estimand and cannot rescue or replicate an unsupported raw endpoint.
transparency: The family-wise revision follows inspection of results and is exploratory, not preregistered or newly confirmatory. Family definitions follow the existing analysis structure, not observed p values. Keep all results, including failures under sensitivity analyses. No one-sided tests or participant exclusions are introduced.
